title.zh: 将北三宝颜省 Leon B. Postigo 市镇 Palandok 描笼涯的 Bacungan 国立中学的 Palandok 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Bacungan National High School – Palandok Annex in Barangay Palandok, Municipality of Leon B. Postigo, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte From the Bacungan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Palandok National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Palandok của Trường Trung học Bacungan Quốc gia tại Barangay Palandok, Đô thị Leon B. Postigo, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Norte khỏi Trường Trung học Bacungan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Palandok Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Palandok ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bacungan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Palandok เทศบาล Leon B. Postigo จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Norte ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bacungan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Palandok แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Palandok, Sekolah Menengah Bacungan Nasional di Barangay Palandok, Kotamadya Leon B. Postigo, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Norte dari Sekolah Menengah Bacungan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Palandok Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Bacungan National High School–Palandok Annex in Barangay Palandok, Municipality of Leon B. Postigo, Province of Zamboanga del Norte is hereby separated from the Bacungan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Palandok National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Bacungan National High School–Palandok Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Palandok National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Palandok National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Bacungan National High School – Palandok Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
